The d/ prefix is used generically for dates across appointment,
payment, and attendance commands. The old name was misleading.

@param was 'appointmentStart' but the actual parameter

Double-escaped newlines caused backslash-n to appear
literally in help text instead of actual newlines.

deterministic and testable. The parser resolves the default
timestamp when the user does not supply a date.
